def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row)]
    vs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h))]
    row_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for i in hs:
        row_ranges.append((start, i))
        start = i + 1
    row_ranges.append((start, h))
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for j in vs:
        col_ranges.append((start, j))
        start = j + 1
    col_ranges.append((start, w))
    tiles = [(a,b,c,d) for a,b in row_ranges for c,d in col_ranges]
    src = next(t for t in tiles if any(grid[i][j] != 9 for i in range(t[0],t[1]) for j in range(t[2],t[3])))
    a,b,c,d = src
    pattern = [row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in tiles:
        for i in range(b-a):
            for j in range(d-c):
                out[a+i][c+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
